coaching.headline: We won seven fights and cashed exactly one, while they won ten and cashed seven. That conversion gap, more than the 3-14 tower count, is the whole 38-minute loss.
coaching.team: Our pre-game read called carry and offlane theirs, but the neutral map was conceded before any of that mattered: the 6-minute Fangtooth fell uncontested with all five of us alive. The pattern set early. Steel and TwinBlast won the river skirmish at 4.4, 3-0, and the other side simply traded it for Fangtooth across the map. We kept winning moments and taking nothing: Eden's solo fight at 11.2, won 2-0, then the fight at their Mini Prime at 18, won 2-1, with Fangtooth again falling cross-map. The collapse ran from 19.1 to 21.2. The fight at their inner tower at 19.1 was lost 1-3 with The Fey alive and ahead. The fight at their Fangtooth at 20.5 was lost 0-3 with Scarlett alive and ahead. Fangtooth, the inner and outer towers, and our first inhibitor all fell between 20.1 and 21.2. To our credit, we caught them out five times and gave back only one solo death, TwinBlast to Khaimera at 21.4. But the major board by the end was brutal. They took Fangtooth at 6 and 14. A third followed at 20. Primal Fangtooth went at 27 and 33. Orb Prime went at 27 and 34, both uncontested while five of us were alive. Our single major all game was the 30-minute Genesis Core. We even won the last fight at their inhibitor at 37.7, 4-2, but The Fey and Eden died in it. Across the map our inhibitor fell at 37.9, with the Core following at 38.3. Next game: the second a fight is won, all five walk to the nearest objective. Seven wins with one cashed is a habit worth breaking.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: Where does a team that wins seven fights lose? In the fights at 19.1 and 20.5. The first, at their inner tower, was lost 1-3 with The Fey alive, ahead, and absent. The second, at their Fangtooth, was lost 0-3 with Scarlett alive, ahead, and absent. Fangtooth, the inner and outer towers, and our first inhibitor all fell in the two minutes after — the game broke in those two fights taken short-handed.

They took three Fangtooths and both Primal Fangtooths, and our only counter-take all game was the 30-minute Genesis Core. Twice Cuban Noobster was alive and ahead but absent, from the fight at their Fangtooth at 20.5, lost 0-3, and from the fight at their river at 36.3, lost 0-2. And 71,838 damage taken with no magic resist bought against a three-magical comp is the build gap behind it.

The death at 16.6 came just before Mini Prime and the inner tower were lost. The death at 25.3 was followed by their Orb Prime a minute later, with an inhibitor alongside it. Steel placed 14 wards to Argus' 26 in a ward war we lost 40-65, with the whole 56.4% Xenia, Dynamo and Gaia Greaves core unbuilt. A support who dies less and sees more changes this game more than any fight would.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Xeebs put up 17 kills, including two solo double-kills at their river, at 11.2 and 27.9, both won 2-0. The fight-winning half of the carry job was elite. The other half was missing: Solaris and Nuclear Rounds from the 62.5% core never built, and the death at 37.9 in the base race came as our inhibitor fell, with the Core following at 38.3.

d7103eb5-3b8e-45c0-ab18-0250d0341237.text: Seven losing fights had The Fey alive and either ahead or simply not joining, spread from 3.6 to 36.3. Mid is the rotation hub, and the hub never rotated.

aaa9bb1a-d2ae-4829-9fb9-bfabc7641e9a.text: solusLupus took an offlane that read theirs all game on paper and was caught out only once in 38 minutes, by Khaimera at 21.4 — survival held in a losing matchup, and the lane still went 6 kills to Gideon's 0.

a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.text: Nine kills and eleven assists bought zero Fangtooths. Five Fangtooth-line spawns went across the map, while our jungle's one major all game was the 30-minute Genesis Core.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.text: Eleven support deaths, and they kept coming just before structures fell. The death at 25.3 alone was followed by an inhibitor at 26.2 and then their Orb Prime right after.

a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.text: 17 kills and two solo river fights won 2-0 — over Drongo and Khaimera at 11.2, then Drongo and Argus at 27.9 — the engine of a team that won seven fights.

coaching.whatWorked: The pick discipline held all game: five enemies caught out alone against a single solo death given back, TwinBlast to Khaimera at 21.4, and seven fights won on the back of it. Finding the fight and winning it needs no fixing.

37.7.call: With the Core race on, the only question left was whose base falls first, and a fight at their inhibitor could not answer it, won or lost. The call was to recall and stand all five on our own Core. Kills across the map changed nothing about which base fell first.

34.8.call: Two players broke the fight open at their inhibitor — where were the other three? With five walking in behind that win, the inhibitor falls and the game likely follows. Instead the kills expired on their death timers with no push behind them.

20.5.call: What could three bodies actually take at their Fangtooth? A contest that cannot be made at full strength is a donation, not a contest. The better call was to concede that spawn, shove the open lanes for something real, and meet the next one five-strong.

a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.build: Cuban Noobster ran Scarlett full lethality: Tainted Blade's healing cut and damage mark, Nightfall's ability-leech and shield, then stacked armor piercing through Spear Of Desolation and The Perforator, and 32,338 hero damage says the offense worked. Rebirth and Salvation were live-twice insurance for a jungler eating 71,838 damage. The one hole the facts flag: no magic resist against a three-magical lineup led by Iggy & Scorch's 72k, so the heaviest incoming damage type arrived with nothing to blunt it.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.eternal: Thraex fits Scarlett's extended-brawl kit: mark one target, hit them harder, take less back, and let Ferocity's stacking attack speed take over as the fight drags. That profile lined up well against Khaimera, another jungler who wants the same long scrap. What it forgoes is burst and utility; the loadout does nothing for the moments Scarlett needs to delete a target quickly or peel for her carry.

d7103eb5-3b8e-45c0-ab18-0250d0341237.build: The Fey's picks each had a reason: Tainted Scepter's healing cut had targets in Khaimera's 12,800 health healed and Argus's 8,284, and Spellbreaker's spell shield blocks one full ability from a three-magical lineup. What went missing was the damage core itself: Combustion's area burst on every combo and Megacosm's burn that takes a slice of the target's maximum health, with Wraith Leggings arriving fifth instead of second. Eight deaths and 17,154 hero damage over 38 minutes is the outcome of itemizing to survive and disrupt without ever scaling the area damage this kit is drafted for.
d7103eb5-3b8e-45c0-ab18-0250d0341237.eternal: Vesh is a natural fit for The Fey: her area abilities touch several enemies at once, and each touch leaves a burn that stacks up across a teamfight. The Tenth Seal supercharges her level-10 ultimate and Mind Rot lets the burn chew tanks. The trade is personal safety; nothing in it helps her live through a dive, so the loadout only pays when she casts from behind her frontline.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.build: Willy Guggenheim stacked Steel with self-preservation: Raiment of Renewal's missing-health regeneration, the armor swells of Unbroken Will and Vainglory, Tainted Charm's healing cut and slow. Eleven deaths and 76,510 damage taken say the game asked more of that armor than it could give. The skipped core answers differently: Xenia shields an ally the moment they get focused, and Dynamo makes anyone Steel locks down take extra damage from everybody; in a game where we won 7 fights and cashed 1, the tools that convert stuns into kills were the ones left unbought.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.eternal: Vesh leans into the half of Steel that deals damage: his ability-heavy kit leaves a burn on everything he hits, and Mind Rot points it at the enemy frontline by scaling with their current health. The Tenth Seal rounds out the level-10 ultimate for the fights that decide the mid game. What it does not do is make him any harder to kill, a real cost in a game where he died eleven times; the surviving is left entirely to his items and positioning.

aaa9bb1a-d2ae-4829-9fb9-bfabc7641e9a.build: solusLupus built TwinBlast close to core: Solaris's self-healing empowered shots, crit through Vanquisher and Imperator, and a well-aimed Tainted Rounds whose healing cut answered Khaimera's 12,800 health healed. Sky Splitter took the slot Ashbringer wanted; Sky Splitter shreds a slice of the target's current health per hit, strongest against tanks, while Ashbringer refunds ability cooldowns on every attack. Against a lineup with a real frontline the current-health shred was a fair trade, and what it mostly cost him was faster ultimates across the long 38-minute grind.
aaa9bb1a-d2ae-4829-9fb9-bfabc7641e9a.eternal: Vermis rewards exactly what TwinBlast does all game: strings of basic attacks on the same target, with every third one adding max-health damage. Serration's missing-health bonus helps him finish the targets he whittles down, and Melting Point stops enemy armor stacking from blanking him. The give-up is burst and safety; into a lane against Gideon's area combos it offers no help surviving the burst, only the promise of out-trading over time.

a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.build: Xeebs's Eden did the killing anyway: 17 kills and 44,510 hero damage off a crit line of Vanquisher, Imperator, and Dust Devil's attack-speed stacking, with Terminus converting extra healing into shields. The skipped pair is an identity question: Nuclear Rounds boosts ability damage and Solaris adds a healing empowered strike, the combination that lets Eden's dashes and casts hit as hard as her attacks. The pure-crit route worked while ahead; its cost showed late, with Tainted Rounds' healing cut against Khaimera's 12,800 healed modeled online only around minute 41 of a 38-minute game.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.eternal: Vermis fits a melee carry who lives on attack strings: every third hit on the same enemy bites for max-health damage, Serration finishes low targets, and Melting Point keeps tanks from shrugging her off. On Eden it compounds the crit build she ran. What it trades is any help with her real problem in this game, surviving the dive; eight deaths came with no defensive tool in the blessing to match.

lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 1,897 hero damage a minute, more than 98% of Iggy & Scorch mid players this patch (36% of the team's). The damage came from Entropy, Megacosm, World Breaker.
Inferno at rank 3: 85s base, about 63.9s by the end (25% shorter) from 33 ability haste: Entropy 15, Megacosm 10, Epoch 8.
Iggy & Scorch dealt 72,072 hero damage, 36% of their team's, with +500 magical power from items.

Penetration: Wraith Leggings 11; against The Fey (level 18: about 89 magical armor, 78 after penetration; took 17,944 magical damage from heroes, 53% of all hero damage they took) and Steel (level 18: about 142 magical armor, 131 after penetration; took 37,979 magical damage from heroes, 56% of all hero damage they took) that is about 6% and 5% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Entropy (item): On dealing Ability Damage: Deal 3 (+3.5%) additional Damage. Each Ability can only trigger this effect once every 0.2s, per Target.
Megacosm (item): On dealing Ability Damage: Deal 2.5% of Target's Max Health as Damage over 3s. Additional applications refresh the duration.
Megacosm (item): On dealing Ability Damage to Heroes: Deal 6% of Target's Bonus Health as Damage over 3s.
World Breaker (item): On dealing Magical Damage to a Hero: Increases your Magical Damage dealt by 2% for 4.5s. Stacks up to 6 times.
Wraith Leggings (item): Against Heroes below 40% Health: Abilities deal 12% bonus Magical Damage.
Vesh (Eternal): Ability damage dealt to Enemy Heroes deals 7% (+0.4% a minute, about 22.2% by the end) of that damage as a DoT over 3s.
Mind Rot (Eternal minor): The major also deals 2% of the target's current health as bonus damage.
Sustain: Orb Of Enlightenment: On Ability Cast: Restore 3% Missing Health over 5s.; Lich: Gain 4%/7%/10%/14% Magical Lifesteal at Levels 1/6/11/16.; 1,851 healing recorded.
Toughness: +850 health, +25% tenacity; took 35,185 damage, mitigated 21,400, died 5 times.

(game text: Increase your Maximum Number of Turrets to 4, but they have 20% less Health.) Field: 50.5% in 3069 games, 41% of picks, level the hero-role's 50.3%.

(game text: Ability damage dealt to Enemy Heroes deals 7% (+0.4% per minute) of that damage as a DoT over 3s.) [7% growing 0.4% a minute: about 22.2% by the end (38 min)] Field: 49.3% in 5070 games, 68% of picks, below the hero-role's 50.3%.

Loadout minor Lich: Heals you from magic damage. Turrets, fire fields and Inferno are all magic damage, so it gives steady sustain. (game text: Gain 4%/7%/10%/14% Magical Lifesteal at Levels 1/6/11/16.) Field: 49.1% in 4539 games, 90% of picks, below the hero-role's 50.3%.

Loadout minor Mind Rot: Your Vesh burn also deals damage based on the target's current health, so your fire hurts healthy, tanky heroes more. (game text: The major also deals 2% of the target's current health as bonus damage.) Field: 48.9% in 4510 games, 89% of picks, below the hero-role's 50.3%.

Loadout crest Epoch: Your panic button. When divers jump you, freeze yourself to wait out their burst while your turrets keep shooting. (game text: Stasis Device:  Enter Stasis for 2.5s.) Field: 50.1% in 5603 games, 76% of picks, level the hero-role's 50.3%.

Stack (Every ability hit set off): 5 effects on one trigger: Entropy, Megacosm, Wraith Leggings, Vesh, Mind Rot. Iggy & Scorch has 4 damaging abilities (Molotov, Oil Spill, Inferno hit an area, so one cast sets them off on several heroes), and 33 ability haste brought them back 25% sooner: more casts, more triggers.
Stack (Damage that scales with the target's health): 2 effects on one trigger: Megacosm, Mind Rot. The more health a target stacks, the more these deal, so health items on the other side fed them.
Stack (Kept alive in fights): 2 effects on one trigger: Orb Of Enlightenment, Megacosm. Together they made staying in a long fight cheaper: more armor, shields or healing the longer it went.
The Eternal was part of it: Vesh (Lich + Mind Rot) sits on the same triggers as the items (every ability hit set off; damage that scales with the target's health), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 2 of the 5 players Iggy & Scorch killed built magical armor (The Fey, Steel). Health items on Steel, Scarlett raised the %-health damage they took. We killed Iggy & Scorch 5 times.

loadout.name: Focal Lens
loadout.text: Hitting an enemy Hero with Tachyon Lance shreds their Physical Armor by 25% for 4s and reduces the cooldown by 10%.
loadout.plain: Landing ranged Q (Tachyon Lance) lowers the target's physical armor and trims its cooldown. Open with the laser so your gun fire and follow-up hit through armor.

loadout.name: Marrow
loadout.text: Heal for 6%/7%/8%/9% of damage dealt to Heroes, increased up to 15%/20%/25%/30% based on your Missing Health. (65% effectiveness for AoE attacks, 15% against monsters.)
loadout.plain: Every hit you land on heroes heals you, and the heal grows the lower your health gets. It stacks with melee stance healing, so swapping to claws when hurt lets you out-sustain a close duel.

loadout.name: Leech
loadout.text: Enemy heroes within 550 units have base Health Regen reduced by 200%.
loadout.plain: Cuts nearby enemies' natural health regen. Mostly a lane tool to stop them healing back between trades.

loadout.name: Roses
loadout.text: Takedowns grant 20 bonus gold per previous takedown, capped at +100g (5 takedowns). Hero kills also grant +50% effectiveness of Marrow’s Major for 8s.
loadout.plain: Bonus gold on takedowns that grows with your streak, and hero kills briefly boost Marrow's healing. Rewards snowballing.

loadout.name: Liberator
loadout.text: Purifying Guard:  Cleanse all Debuffs. Gain a 80 (+100%) Shield for 2.5s.
loadout.plain: Removes slows, stuns and other debuffs and gives a short shield. Save it for when you get caught, then keep shooting or swap stance and fight back.
